parts.title: Kestrel-1 Command Pod
parts.description: Single-seat command pod with a side hatch for EVA, small built-in reaction wheel, battery and monopropellant reserve.

parts.title: Albatross-3 Command Pod
parts.description: Roomy three-seat command pod with a large side hatch. Needs a 2.5 m heat shield for reentry.

parts.title: Wren Probe Core
parts.description: Uncrewed guidance unit. Provides control and stability assist for test vehicles and spent stages. Draws a trickle of electric charge.

parts.title: LT-100 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Short 1.25 m liquid propellant tank.

parts.title: LT-200 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Medium 1.25 m liquid propellant tank.

parts.title: LT-400 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Long 1.25 m liquid propellant tank.

parts.title: HT-800 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Short 2.5 m liquid propellant tank.

parts.title: HT-3200 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Long 2.5 m liquid propellant tank for heavy first stages.

parts.title: TA-21 Taper Adapter Tank
parts.description: Conical 2.5 m to 1.25 m adapter carrying liquid propellant.

parts.title: Pip-50 Mini Tank
parts.description: Tiny 0.625 m propellant tank for probes and small landers.

parts.title: Hornet LV-215 Engine
parts.description: Gimballed 1.25 m lifter engine. Strong at sea level, restartable. Generates electric charge while firing.

parts.title: Ember VX-60 Vacuum Engine
parts.description: Efficient restartable 1.25 m engine for upper stages and landers. Weak in thick air.

parts.title: Goliath LV-650 Engine
parts.description: Heavy 2.5 m first-stage engine with a modest gimbal.

parts.title: Spark MX-18 Engine
parts.description: Tiny 0.625 m engine for probes, small landers and fine manoeuvring.

parts.title: Pogo SR-230 Solid Booster
parts.description: Solid rocket booster. Cannot be throttled or shut down once lit; burns about 23 s.

parts.title: Kodiak SR-300 Solid Booster
parts.description: Long-burning solid booster (about 44 s). Ideal as strap-on boosters via radial decouplers.

parts.title: SD-1 Stack Decoupler
parts.description: Separates the stage below from the vessel. Blocks propellant crossfeed. Stays with the lower stage.

parts.title: SD-2 Heavy Stack Decoupler
parts.description: 2.5 m stack decoupler. Blocks propellant crossfeed.

parts.title: RD-1 Radial Decoupler
parts.description: Holds a side-mounted booster and pushes it clear when fired. Attach it to a tank, then attach the booster to it.

parts.title: LS-2 Landing Strut
parts.description: Retractable damped landing leg (toggle with G). Breaks if it strikes the ground faster than 12 m/s.

parts.title: LS-5 Heavy Landing Strut
parts.description: Long-travel landing leg for heavy landers.

parts.title: Canopy-16 Main Parachute
parts.description: Main parachute. Arms when staged, semi-deploys once pressure exceeds 4 kPa (below ~18 km) and fully opens 1000 m above the ground. Tears if the canopy load exceeds 100 kN (opening far above terminal speed) and burns above 700 K (deployed in reentry heat).

parts.title: Drogue-6 Drogue Chute
parts.description: Small, strong chute that can open at higher speed and altitude (2500 m) to slow a capsule before the mains.

parts.title: Canopy-R Radial Parachute
parts.description: Side-mounted main parachute for heavier capsules. Use in symmetric pairs.

parts.title: HS-125 Ablative Heat Shield
parts.description: Ablative shield for 1.25 m capsules. Point it into the airflow (retrograde) during reentry; ablator burns away as it absorbs heat.

parts.title: HS-250 Ablative Heat Shield
parts.description: Ablative shield for 2.5 m capsules.

parts.title: Cell-100 Battery Pack
parts.description: Surface-mounted battery storing 100 EC for reaction wheels and probe cores.

parts.title: Cell-400 Battery Bank
parts.description: Inline 1.25 m battery bank storing 400 EC.

parts.title: Gyro-S Reaction Wheel
parts.description: Inline 1.25 m reaction wheel: 12 kN*m per axis. Draws electric charge while applying torque.

parts.title: Gyro-L Reaction Wheel
parts.description: Inline 2.5 m reaction wheel: 36 kN*m per axis.

parts.title: Quad-4 RCS Thruster Block
parts.description: Four monopropellant thrusters for rotation and translation (toggle RCS with R; translate with H/N/I/J/K/L). Mount in symmetric groups around the centre of mass.

parts.title: MP-150 Monopropellant Tank
parts.description: Inline tank with 150 kg of monopropellant for RCS.

parts.title: MP-R Radial Monoprop Tank
parts.description: Small side-mounted monopropellant tank (40 kg).

parts.title: Clasp-1 Docking Port
parts.description: Androgynous docking port. Two ports facing each other within 0.6 m and 1 m/s capture automatically. Undock from the part menu.

parts.title: Aero Nose Cone
parts.description: Streamlined 1.25 m nose cone. Greatly reduces drag on top of a stack or booster.

parts.title: FS-1 Stabilizer Fin
parts.description: Fixed tail fin. Place 3-4 near the bottom of a rocket (symmetry) to move the centre of pressure aft and keep it pointing prograde.

parts.title: Rocketeer on EVA
parts.description: A crew member in a pressure suit with a small monopropellant jetpack.

parts.title: Mission Flag
parts.description: A flag planted to mark a landing site.

parts.title: Mayfly-1 Lander Can
parts.description: Light one-seat lander can for short hops and moon landings. No heat shield: not for reentry.

parts.title: Finch Micro Probe
parts.description: Tiny probe core with a small battery. Keeps a small craft pointing where it is told, and little else.

parts.title: Sparrow Radial Probe
parts.description: A very light probe core that mounts on the side of a craft or a stage. Stability assist only.

parts.title: Mayfly-2 Lander Can
parts.description: Two-seat lander can with wide windows. Built for the Moon and short hops; no heat shield.

parts.title: Starling Advanced Probe
parts.description: Probe core with every attitude-hold mode, for craft that fly themselves.

parts.title: Owl Heavy Probe
parts.description: Heavy probe core with a strong reaction wheel and a large battery, for big uncrewed stages.

parts.title: Perch External Seat
parts.description: An open seat on the side of a craft. A rocketeer rides it in a suit, with no cabin around.

parts.title: Bunk Crew Cabin
parts.description: A two-seat cabin with bunks and no controls. Adds seats to a long mission.

parts.title: Hitch Crew Module
parts.description: A four-seat crew module with no controls. Roomy, heavy and well insulated.

parts.title: Lookout Cupola
parts.description: One seat under a ring of windows, with control of the craft. The best view for docking and station keeping.

parts.title: Quill Research Lab
parts.description: A two-seat laboratory module. Crew inside turn stored science data into more of it.

parts.title: Pip-25 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Short 0.625 m propellant tank for probes and small landers.

parts.title: Pip-100 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Long 0.625 m propellant tank for probes and small landers.

parts.title: LT-800 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Extra-long 1.25 m propellant tank.

parts.title: HT-1600 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Medium 2.5 m propellant tank.

parts.title: TA-10 Taper Adapter Tank
parts.description: Conical 1.25 m to 0.625 m adapter carrying propellant.

parts.title: HT-6400 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Very long 2.5 m propellant tank for heavy stages.

parts.title: XT-3600 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Short 3.75 m propellant tank.

parts.title: XT-7200 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Medium 3.75 m propellant tank.

parts.title: XT-14400 Propellant Tank
parts.description: Long 3.75 m propellant tank for first stages.

parts.title: TA-32 Taper Adapter Tank
parts.description: Conical 3.75 m to 2.5 m adapter carrying propellant.

parts.title: Saddle Radial Tank
parts.description: A side-mounted propellant tank for drop tanks and boosters.

parts.title: XG-40 Xenon Tank
parts.description: A small 0.625 m tank of xenon for ion engines. It holds 40 kg.

parts.title: XG-20 Xenon Tank
parts.description: A side-mounted tank of xenon for ion engines. It holds 20 kg.

parts.title: HY-140 Hydrogen Tank
parts.description: A long 1.25 m insulated hydrogen tank for nuclear engines. It holds 140 kg.

parts.title: HY-1100 Hydrogen Tank
parts.description: A long 2.5 m insulated hydrogen tank for nuclear engines. It holds 1,100 kg.

parts.title: Twin Coupler
parts.description: Splits a 2.5 m stack into two 1.25 m stacks. Holds propellant.

parts.title: Triple Coupler
parts.description: Splits a 2.5 m stack into three 1.25 m stacks. Holds propellant.

parts.title: Quad Coupler
parts.description: Splits a 3.75 m stack into four 1.25 m stacks. Holds propellant.

parts.title: Gnat Lander Engine
parts.description: Light restartable engine for landers and probes. A lot of thrust for its weight.

parts.title: Cricket Radial Engine
parts.description: Mounts on the side of a stage. Fixed nozzle, strong at sea level.

parts.title: Wasp LV-300 Engine
parts.description: High-thrust 1.25 m lifter. More push than the Hornet for more weight.

parts.title: Albacore VX-400 Engine
parts.description: Large vacuum engine with a wide bell for upper stages.

parts.title: Centipede Cluster
parts.description: Four fixed nozzles on one 2.5 m mount, for heavy lifts and big landers.

parts.title: Titan LV-2000 Engine
parts.description: The heavy 3.75 m lifter for the biggest first stages.

parts.title: Lantern NTR
parts.description: A nuclear-thermal engine. It heats hydrogen in a reactor: very high Isp, low thrust, and it gets hot.

parts.title: Glimmer Ion Drive
parts.description: An ion drive. It turns electricity and xenon into a tiny, endless thrust.

parts.title: Leviathan VX-1500 Engine
parts.description: The heavy 3.75 m vacuum engine for big transfer stages.

parts.title: Wedge Aerospike
parts.description: An aerospike: nearly the same Isp from the pad to vacuum, with a flat plug in place of a bell.

parts.title: Vernier Thruster
parts.description: A small side thruster for trim and attitude on the chemical mix.

parts.title: Spit Separation Motor
parts.description: A tiny solid motor that pushes a spent stage away. It burns for about a second.

parts.title: Bison Long Booster
parts.description: A very long 1.25 m solid booster for a second pair of boosters.

parts.title: Behemoth Heavy Booster
parts.description: A heavy 2.5 m solid booster. Cannot be throttled or shut down once lit.

parts.title: SD-0 Stack Decoupler
parts.description: Separates the stage below a 0.625 m stack. Blocks propellant crossfeed.

parts.title: SS-1 Separator
parts.description: Separates a 1.25 m stack so that both halves drift apart. Blocks crossfeed.

parts.title: SS-2 Separator
parts.description: Separates a 2.5 m stack so that both halves drift apart. Blocks crossfeed.

parts.title: SD-3 Heavy Stack Decoupler
parts.description: Separates the stage below a 3.75 m stack. Blocks propellant crossfeed.

parts.title: SS-0 Separator
parts.description: Separates a 0.625 m stack so that both halves drift apart. Blocks crossfeed.

parts.title: SS-3 Separator
parts.description: Separates a 3.75 m stack so that both halves drift apart. Blocks crossfeed.

parts.title: RD-2 Heavy Radial Decoupler
parts.description: Holds a big side-mounted booster and pushes it clear when fired.

parts.title: Clasp-0 Docking Port
parts.description: Androgynous docking port for 0.625 m craft. Captures within 0.4 m.

parts.title: Clasp-2 Docking Port
parts.description: Androgynous docking port for 2.5 m craft. Captures within 1 m.

parts.title: TR-1 Truss
parts.description: A one-metre truss for stations and landers.

parts.title: TR-3 Truss
parts.description: A three-metre truss for stations and landers.

parts.title: Cube Node
parts.description: A small cube with a node on every face, for stations and landers.

parts.title: Structural Plate S1
parts.description: A flat 1.25 m plate to mount parts on.

parts.title: Structural Plate S2
parts.description: A flat 2.5 m plate to mount parts on.

parts.title: Structural Plate S3
parts.description: A flat 3.75 m plate to mount parts on.

parts.title: Hollow Adapter
parts.description: A light 2.5 m to 1.25 m adapter with no tank.

parts.title: SB-1 Service Bay
parts.description: An enclosed 1.25 m bay with doors. Cargo inside gets no drag and no heating.

parts.title: SB-2 Service Bay
parts.description: An enclosed 2.5 m bay with doors. Cargo inside gets no drag and no heating.

parts.title: Clasp-1S Shielded Docking Port
parts.description: An inline docking port with a cover that closes when not in use.

parts.title: Strut Connector
parts.description: A rigid link between two parts, to stiffen a long craft.

parts.title: Fuel Line
parts.description: A pipe that carries propellant from one tank to another part, past the decouplers.

parts.title: Anchor Launch Clamp
parts.description: Holds the rocket on the pad until the engines are at full thrust, then lets go.

parts.title: LS-1 Mini Strut
parts.description: A small landing leg for probes and light landers. Breaks above 10 m/s.

parts.title: LS-9 Heavy Strut
parts.description: A heavy landing leg for big landers and surface bases.

parts.title: Canopy-6 Parachute
parts.description: Small main parachute for 0.625 m probes and light capsules.

parts.title: Canopy-32 Parachute
parts.description: Big main parachute for heavy capsules and thin air.

parts.title: HS-60 Ablative Heat Shield
parts.description: Ablative shield for 0.625 m probes and capsules.

parts.title: Drogue-24 Parachute
parts.description: A large drogue that slows a heavy craft before the main canopy opens.

parts.title: HS-375 Ablative Heat Shield
parts.description: Ablative shield for 3.75 m craft. Point it into the airflow during reentry.

parts.title: Bloom Inflatable Shield
parts.description: A 1.25 m stack that inflates into a wide shield, for heavy landers that need a gentler entry.

parts.title: MP-25 Monoprop Tank
parts.description: Small 0.625 m monopropellant tank for RCS.

parts.title: Gyro-XS Reaction Wheel
parts.description: Inline 0.625 m reaction wheel for small craft.

parts.title: Gyro-R Reaction Wheel
parts.description: A small reaction wheel that mounts on the side of a craft.

parts.title: Linear RCS Port
parts.description: A single RCS nozzle for translation or trim.

parts.title: Cell-50 Battery
parts.description: A 0.625 m battery disc storing 50 EC.

parts.title: SP-F Fixed Panel
parts.description: A small fixed solar panel that is always on. It delivers power in sunlight.

parts.title: SP-2 Folding Panel
parts.description: A deployable solar panel. It folds flat for launch and opens in orbit.

parts.title: Whip Antenna
parts.description: A short whip antenna: fast and cheap on power, short range.

parts.title: DS-1 Dish
parts.description: A medium dish antenna for the inner system.

parts.title: Spotlight
parts.description: A narrow lamp for night landings and work.

parts.title: Fixed Ladder
parts.description: A fixed ladder for a rocketeer to climb.

parts.title: MP-600 Monoprop Toroid
parts.description: A ring-shaped 2.5 m monopropellant tank that leaves the middle free.

parts.title: Gyro-XL Reaction Wheel
parts.description: Inline 3.75 m reaction wheel for the biggest craft.

parts.title: Duo RCS Block
parts.description: Two RCS nozzles on one block, for trim and small craft.

parts.title: Cell-1600 Battery Bank
parts.description: A 2.5 m battery bank storing 1,600 EC.

parts.title: SP-8 Solar Wing
parts.description: A large deployable solar wing for big craft and stations.

parts.title: RP-1 Radiator
parts.description: A fixed radiator that sheds heat from the parts beside it.

parts.title: RF-3 Folding Radiator
parts.description: A folding radiator that opens in space for three times the area.

parts.title: HG-5 High-Gain Dish
parts.description: A large dish for the outer system. Long range, slow to deploy.

parts.title: Floodlight
parts.description: A wide lamp that lights a landing site or a work area.

parts.title: Telescopic Ladder
parts.description: A ladder that extends from a short stowed length to four metres.

parts.title: Sunfield Array
parts.description: A huge solar array on a tracking mount that follows the star.

parts.title: Hearth RTG
parts.description: A radioisotope generator: constant power anywhere, heavy, and warm to the touch.

parts.title: FC-1 Fuel Cell
parts.description: Turns the chemical mix into electricity. It runs only while the tanks last.

parts.title: FC-8 Fuel Cell Array
parts.description: Eight fuel cells in a 1.25 m ring, for a station that runs on its tanks.

parts.title: RL-10 Active Radiator
parts.description: A large active radiator: it uses electricity to move heat away faster.

parts.title: NC-0 Nose Cone
parts.description: Streamlined 0.625 m nose cone. Greatly reduces drag on top of a stack.

parts.title: NC-2 Nose Cone
parts.description: Streamlined 2.5 m nose cone. Greatly reduces drag on top of a stack.

parts.title: PF-1 Fairing Base
parts.description: The base ring of a 1.25 m fairing. The shell grows from it and drops away in two halves.

parts.title: PF-2 Fairing Base
parts.description: The base ring of a 2.5 m fairing. The shell grows from it and drops away in two halves.

parts.title: FS-2 Swept Fin
parts.description: A bigger swept tail fin. Place three or four near the bottom of a rocket.

parts.title: NC-3 Nose Cone
parts.description: Streamlined 3.75 m nose cone. Greatly reduces drag on top of a stack.

parts.title: PF-3 Fairing Base
parts.description: The base ring of a 3.75 m fairing. The shell grows from it and drops away in two halves.

parts.title: FT-2 Tail Fin
parts.description: A large tail fin for 2.5 m rockets.

parts.title: CF-1 Canard
parts.description: A small actuated control surface that steers by itself.

parts.title: CF-4 Control Fin
parts.description: A large actuated control surface for steering in the air.

parts.title: AB-1 Airbrake
parts.description: A panel that opens to add drag on the way down.

parts.title: GF-1 Grid Fin
parts.description: A lattice fin that steers a booster back to the pad.

parts.title: Thermal Probe
parts.description: Measures temperature. Works anywhere, and says what it found.

parts.title: Pressure Gauge
parts.description: Measures air pressure. A reading in vacuum is a reading too.

parts.title: Bio-Culture Canister
parts.description: A canister of cultures to expose to a new place. Single use.

parts.title: Materials Exposure Rack
parts.description: A rack of samples to expose to a new place. Single use.

parts.title: Seismic Array
parts.description: Listens to the ground. Works on the surface only.

parts.title: Air Sampler
parts.description: Samples the air and says what it is made of.

parts.title: Gravimeter
parts.description: Maps the pull of gravity from orbit or the ground.

parts.title: Rover Wheel S
parts.description: A powered rover wheel with suspension and steering (S size).

parts.title: Rover Wheel M
parts.description: A powered rover wheel with suspension and steering (M size).

parts.title: Rover Wheel L
parts.description: A powered rover wheel with suspension and steering (L size).

parts.title: Rover Chassis
parts.description: A flat body with mounting points for wheels, a pod and a battery.

parts.title: Drill S
parts.description: A drill for the ground or a grabbed asteroid.

parts.title: Drill L
parts.description: A large drill for the ground or a grabbed asteroid.

parts.title: Converter S
parts.description: Turns ore into propellant, with electricity. It makes heat.

parts.title: Converter L
parts.description: A large converter from ore to propellant. It needs radiators.

parts.title: Survey Scanner
parts.description: Maps ore from a low polar orbit.

parts.title: Narrow-band Scanner
parts.description: Shows the ore under the craft in detail, from a low orbit.

parts.title: Surface Sensor
parts.description: Measures the ore at the landing spot.

parts.title: Ore Tank S1
parts.description: A 1.25 m tank for ore.

parts.title: Ore Tank S2
parts.description: A 2.5 m tank for ore.

parts.title: Grabbing Unit
parts.description: Latches onto debris or an asteroid and holds it.
